answer_2.quote: The generation quality metrics include Fréchet Distance (FD), Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KL), and Inception Score (IS). We also compare our model with previous non-generative models using STFT Distance (STFT) and Envelope Distance (ENV).

answer_3.quote: we first establish an assessment model by finetuning Llama-3.1-8B on the SpatialTAS with the spatial audio reasoning task. Then we utilize the assessment model to assess the spatial semantic coherence between our generated audio and text prompts.
methods: spatial audio question answering using a fine‑tuned LLM as an evaluator
